extraction.name: WebWalker: Benchmarking LLMs in Web Traversal
extraction.description: WebWalkerQA is a benchmark designed to assess the ability of LLMs to perform web traversal. It evaluates the capacity of LLMs to traverse a website's subpages to extract high-quality data systematically.
extraction.creator: Jialong Wu, Wenbiao Yin, Yong Jiang, Zhenglin Wang, Zekun Xi, Runnan Fang, Linhai Zhang, Yulan He, Deyu Zhou, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The data collection process involves a two-stage funnel annotation strategy, combining LLM-based and human annotation. In the first stage, GPT-4o performs initial annotations, followed by a second stage where crowd-sourced human annotators conduct quality control and filtering to refine the final results.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data collection involves traversing official websites recursively, collecting information on accessible sub-links and their respective pages.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The data preprocessing protocol involves constructing queries based on the provided page information and specified role, verifying and filtering for legitimate queries that deviate from natural, human-like phrasing, and retaining only QA pairs with short answers containing entities.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The data annotation protocol involves human annotators rewriting and calibrating the questions and answers to ensure the QA pairs are correct and consistent.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The data annotation analysis involves evaluating the correctness of responses by comparing the predicted answer with the ground truth using CoT prompting strategy.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset has a diverse distribution of languages and domains to ensure a comprehensive evaluation, reflecting real-world web environments.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset size is currently 680 high-quality QA pairs, with a collection of approximately 14k silver QA pairs that can serve as supplementary training data. The dataset only utilizes HTML-DOM to parse clickable buttons and does not incorporate visual modalities like screenshots.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used for evaluating LLMs' web traversal abilities in complex, multi-step information-seeking tasks, and can be integrated with RAG systems to expand their scope.
